Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate the "seconds" part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Simple Series Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on Emerald for the current session.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on Emerald system today.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Emerald Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted Option value

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: Long Term Option value

Field.Name: Active on Emerald
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on Emerald in the current session

Field.Name: Emerald BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by Emerald

Field.Name: Liquidity Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Quote/Order acceptance as per Emerald rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market

Field.Name: Priority Quote Width
Field.Description: Maximum allowable width for a quote for this Option during regular trading in order to be considered as Priority Quote. 0 when Priority Quote Width is not applicable.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Definition Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate stock option strategies traded on Emerald for the current session.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this Strategy is added/updated on Emerald system today.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Emerald Strategy ID is assigned per trading day and is valid only for that day.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for this strategy

Field.Name: Active on Emerald
Field.Description: Indicates if this strategy is tradable on Emerald in the current session

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Update Reason
Field.Description: Update Reason value

Field.Name: Reserved 10
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Number of Legs
Field.Description: Number of Legs. Variable from 2 to 8

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify the firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to each Underlying group. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Name: AIS Version
Field.Description: Eg: AIS1.0

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID for the current trading session

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current system status

Message.Name: Simple Liquidity Seeking Event Notification Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate information each time a Liquidity seeking event (defined in Event Type field below) starts at Emerald.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this notification was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Emerald Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Type of Event

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O': always 0. When Event Type is 'R', or 'P': Unique Event ID for the current event.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Current price of the Event. Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Imbalance Side
Field.Description: This is the side of the excess liquidity that is waiting to get matched. Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 1
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O', 'R', or 'P': MatchQty - Number of contracts ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present). Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 2
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O' or 'R': Routable Quantity. Number of contracts that may be routed. Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 3
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O' or 'R': Imbalance Quantity. Number of contracts on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched. Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Quantity 4
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'O' or 'R': Must Fill Quantity. Number of contracts, on the provided Side, that must be matched at the provided Price. These contracts are crossing the provided Price and Emerald is seeking liquidity for these contracts. Other Event Types: 0 (zero). Please refer to Appendix C for details.

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned Attributable ID (Executing Broker MPID) of an Order. Otherwise, it is space filled.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Complex Liquidity Seeking Event Notification Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate information each time a Liquidity seeking event (defined in Event Type field below) starts at Emerald

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this notification was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Emerald Strategy ID is assigned per trading day and is valid only for that day.

Field.Name: Event Type
Field.Description: Type of Event

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: Unique Event ID for the current event.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side. When Event Type is 'P': Agency side of the cPRIME order being auctioned

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The net limit price for the strategy. When Event Type is 'P': Auction Start Price of the cPRIME auction

Field.Name: Matched Quantity
Field.Description: Number of strategies ready to be matched (both buyers and sellers already present).

Field.Name: Imbalance Quantity
Field.Description: When Event Type is 'C': Number of strategies on the Imbalance Side that cannot be matched. Other Even Types: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned Attributable ID (Executing Broker MPID) of the Order. Otherwise, it is space filled.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: Underlying Trading Status Notification Message
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of changes to the trading status of all the options of an underlying.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status value

Field.Name: Event Reason
Field.Description: Event Reason value

Field.Name: Expected Event Time: Seconds Part
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the expected time of the event. Always use in conjunction with the Nano-seconds part field.

Field.Name: Expected Event Time: Nano-Seconds Part
Field.Description: Nano-seconds portion of the expected time of the event. Specifies number of nano-seconds since the seconds specified in "Expected Event Time Seconds" field.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Option leg: Emerald Defined Series. See Simple Series Update Message. Stock leg: 0 (zero)

Field.Name: Leg Ratio Qty
Field.Description: The ratio of this individual leg. Number of option contracts or Number of stock shares for this leg is: LegRatioQty * OrderQty

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: The side of this individual leg

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: Emerald will accept position closing orders only

Value.Name: No
Value.Description: Emerald will accept open and close positions

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: Far month expiration (as defined by Emerald rules)

Value.Name: No
Value.Description: Near month expiration (as defined by Emerald rules)

Value.Name: Penny Or Nickel
Value.Description: Penny if Price <= $3, Nickel if Price > $3

Value.Name: Nickel Or Dime
Value.Description: Nickel if Price <= $3, Dime if Price > $3

Value.Name: Penny Or Nickel
Value.Description: Penny if Price <= $3, Nickel if Price > $3

Value.Name: Nickel Or Dime
Value.Description: Nickel if Price <= $3, Dime if Price > $3

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Emerald has halted trading for this Underlying Symbol

Value.Name: Resumed
Value.Description: Emerald will resume trading (reopen) for this Underlying Symbol

Value.Name: Opened
Value.Description: Emerald will open trading for this Underlying Symbol

Value.Name: Automatic
Value.Description: This event resulted from automatic/market driven event
